title: A user with the existing inventory-reports permission can open the report — no new permission is added
custom_preconds:
1. A test user exists whose role has the existing inventory-reports permission (assign the Tech user a suitable role if needed; restore the original role afterward).
2. You are signed in as that user on a desktop browser.
custom_steps:
1. Open the reports navigation and find "Inventory Value" under the Parts group.
2. Open the report and confirm it loads rows.
3. Download the current view as a CSV.
custom_expected:
1. The report is listed and opens normally for a user holding the existing inventory-reports permission.
2. No additional, report-specific permission is required — the report reuses the existing inventory-reports permission.
